title: Parse and format compact durations ('1h30m')
requirements: parse_duration accepts d/h/m/s parts in that order ('2d4h', '90s', '1h30m15s') and returns total seconds as an int
Empty strings, unknown units, and repeated or out-of-order units raise ValueError
format_duration(seconds) is the inverse, omitting zero parts ('0s' for zero)
user_messages: durations.parse_duration('1h30m') → seconds as an int. parts are d, h, m, s and they come in that order, e.g. '2d4h', '90s', '1h30m15s'
empty string, unknown unit, or units repeated / out of order → ValueError
and format_duration(seconds) going back the other way, skip the zero parts, '0s' for zero
